title: Set and Map

blocks.md:
## Unique names, keyed lookup

A `Set` keeps each value once. `new Set(["east", "east", "south"])` has size `2`. A `Map` stores a value under a key you choose — not only a string field on an object.

The desk uses a set to scrub a log (`east` twice is still one heading) and a map to look up a beacon by name. `map.get("north")` is missing when the key was never set — that is `undefined`, not a throw.

choices.md: `2` — the second east was already there
